QUOTE: The asm paths are gated by `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM` (`constant_time_impl.h:42`). That needs `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM`, which is on in the shipped `mbedtls_config.h:52` and off in `configs/config-symmetric-only.h`, plus `__GNUC__` or `__ARMCC_VERSION`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM requires MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros (`__GNUC__`/`__ARMCC_VERSION`), which conveys that it is derived. It never says "not configured in mbedtls_config.h" in so many words, but that follows from the description.
